course.name: Automation Recipes
course.description: Choose one automation, build it and test a repeat or failure.
course.longDescription: 23 minutes for the required path: 3 minutes to choose a recipe and a 20-minute capstone that includes the chosen 15-minute lab and its review. Open your chosen recipe from the course contents before completing the capstone. The five recipe lessons each show a standalone 15-minute estimate; the other four are optional. Prerequisites depend on the recipe: Events for scheduling/messaging, Storage and Tables for files, API Integrations for HTTP. Choose a recipe whose test environment you can access. Each lab finishes with manual outcome evidence.

modules.title: Build and check
modules.description: Complete the practical steps and inspect the result.

lessons.title: Choose one recipe and define its result

challenges.prompt: A flow overwrites the same report file but sends mail on every retry. Which part still needs a repeat policy?
challenges.explanation: The mail send, separately from the repeatable file write.

options.label: The mail send, separately from the repeatable file write.
Only the report filename.
Nothing, because one step is repeatable.

lessons.title: Optional recipe: triage a test inbox

challenges.prompt: Draft creation succeeds and marking the mail seen fails. What should recovery account for?
challenges.explanation: The existing draft must be reconciled before creating another response.

options.label: The mail cannot reappear because Create Draft marked it automatically.
The next attempt should always send immediately.
The existing draft must be reconciled before creating another response.

lessons.title: Optional recipe: write a weekly report

challenges.prompt: The same weekly report was emailed twice even though only one file exists. What explains it?
challenges.explanation: The file path deduplicated the file write, not the independent send.

options.label: The report needs a random filename on every retry.
The file path deduplicated the file write, not the independent send.
Cron automatically prevents duplicate sends, so the evidence is impossible.

lessons.title: Optional recipe: answer in a test chat

challenges.prompt: A bot stops when the laptop closes. What should the deployment decision inspect?
challenges.explanation: Where its active adapter runs and whether a supported continuously running delivery path is configured.

options.label: Where its active adapter runs and whether a supported continuously running delivery path is configured.
Only whether the token string is long enough.
Whether the app has a Page called Bot.

challenges.prompt: An updated CSV is reported by Diff Directory but the flow only loops over Added. What is missing?
challenges.explanation: A deliberate Updated branch, including the output replacement and commit policy.

options.label: Another manifest for every individual run.
A random output name so changes never overwrite.
A deliberate Updated branch, including the output replacement and commit policy.

lessons.title: Optional recipe: create one remote record

challenges.prompt: Why can the supplied mock safely receive the same operation twice?
challenges.explanation: It enforces the same key/body contract atomically on the receiver.

options.label: Because POST never changes state.
It enforces the same key/body contract atomically on the receiver.

lessons.title: Build one recipe and review the result

challenges.prompt: A recipe’s first write succeeds and its checkpoint fails. What must the next attempt know?
challenges.explanation: Which effect may already exist and how the same operation is reconciled or repeated safely.

options.label: Which effect may already exist and how the same operation is reconciled or repeated safely.
Only that the overall run was red.
A fresh random ID to avoid looking at the prior attempt.

challenges.prompt: A recipe works manually but no scheduled run appears. Which evidence should you inspect first?
challenges.explanation: The trigger activation, next occurrence, runtime availability and delivery history.

options.label: Only the transform output format.
The app icon.
The trigger activation, next occurrence, runtime availability and delivery history.

challenges.prompt: A green run wrote the wrong rows. Is the recipe ready for scheduling?
challenges.explanation: No. Correct the transformation and verify the actual output against the fixture.

options.label: Yes, if the schedule is slow enough.
No. Correct the transformation and verify the actual output against the fixture.
